Trombonist Eddie Bert was born in Yonkers, New York on May 16, 1922. He was inspired by early recordings of Lester Young and took lessons from Basie trombonist Benny Morton. He has played with a lengthy list of top big bands, including ensembles led by Benny Goodman, Stan Kenton and Woody Herman.

Eddie has played on numerous recordings, including historical LPs by Charles Mingus, Thad Jones and Thelonious Monk. He continues to compose and perform as he enters his sixth decade as a professional musician.
Eddie was interviewed in Danbury, Connecticut on November 20, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
